title: Charming East Nash Bungalow Close to Downtown
description:
🏡 Great location! This East Nashville bungalow is only 8 min. to Opryland, 15 min. from Downtown & BNA airport. Newly renovated, hardwood floors, granite countertops, 2 spacious bedrooms with memory foam queen mattresses and twin trundle. Sleeps up to 5. Experience the artistic neighborhood of east nashville. Coffee shops/cafes only 3 min away. Note: No smoking/parties allowed. Note: This is my personal home I Airbnb while I’m traveling (I’m a musician).

The space
🏠 Get an authentic east nashville artist’s home experience with this beautiful newly renovated house w/ hardwood floors, granite countertops, 2 spacious bedrooms. Enjoy delicious coffee shops and restaurants minutes away. Full Kitchen, two memory foam queen mattresses and memory foam twin trundle.

Guest access
Will message you access code day of check in.

Other things to note
No fire in fire pit use, no smoking, parties, or animals. This is my personal home. Quiet hours after 10pm.
